task_objective: Keep important personal files recoverable in two distinct storage locations and maintain those copies.

rius.description: Keep recoverable copies of the selected important files in two distinct storage locations, including a backup separate from the working location, rather than merely moving the only copy or duplicating folders on the same storage device.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Keep recoverable copies of the selected important files in two distinct storage locations, including a backup separate from the working location, rather than merely moving the only copy or duplicating folders on the same storage device.

rius.rationale: Without separate recoverable copies the requested two-location protection is absent and one ordinary storage loss can destroy the only data.

rius.description: Verify that the copied files are present and usable, for example by opening samples, comparing the copied set or performing a small restore check.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Verify that the copied files are present and usable, for example by opening samples, comparing the copied set or performing a small restore check.

rius.rationale: Checks recoverability while accepting simple validation rather than requiring every integrity technique; omission alone does not defeat an otherwise sound copying procedure.

rius.description: Refresh the backup copies when important files change or on an appropriate recurring schedule.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Refresh the backup copies when important files change or on an appropriate recurring schedule.

rius.rationale: Keeps the process useful after the first copy without imposing a fixed cadence or backup product.

notes: E4 draft; frozen prompt corpus v0.3.1, protocol 0.3, annotation schema 0.2. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants ask for a small important-file set using two different locations. They do not specify a third location or a 3-2-1 architecture. Boundaries: Two-location recoverable copying, verification and refresh are distinct. The shared minimum is recoverable copies in two distinct storage locations with a real backup separate from the working location; an intact working copy can be one of the two. Two extra backups, a third total copy, a particular cloud provider and a mandatory offsite product are not inferred. Moving the only copy is not copying. Equivalent wording, scripts and numerals are accepted. Defeating contradictions override positive anchors; a refusal/non-answer scores 0 on every RIU. CHECK-01 is separate and can flag the same span as an RIU error.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Record relevant design or methodological differences across the studies.

scoring_rule.1: Record how outcomes were defined or measured, including relevant scale or observation-window differences.

rius.description: Use assessed comparability to explain which findings can be combined or juxtaposed and how, through an appropriate grouped, narrative or justified quantitative synthesis rather than indiscriminate pooling.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.

rius.rationale: Without a comparability-based synthesis method the answer either lists studies or treats unlike findings as interchangeable.

rius.description: Limit conclusions to the populations, methods and outcomes the evidence supports, preserving important heterogeneity or unresolved incompatibility rather than claiming one universal directly equivalent effect.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Limit conclusions to the populations, methods and outcomes the evidence supports, preserving important heterogeneity or unresolved incompatibility rather than claiming one universal directly equivalent effect.

rius.rationale: Makes interpretation limits explicit, but an otherwise adequate comparability-based synthesis can remain valid without a separately stated conclusion-scope step; an actual unsupported universal claim is still a task-check error.

task_objective: Transfer a file too large for an email attachment through a suitable method and make it retrievable by its recipient.

rius.description: Use a transfer approach that actually resolves the email-size limit for this file, such as a suitable upload/link transfer, another viable medium or compression when it makes a usable attachment fit.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Use a transfer approach that actually resolves the email-size limit for this file, such as a suitable upload/link transfer, another viable medium or compression when it makes a usable attachment fit.

rius.rationale: Without a size-capable mechanism the user still cannot transfer the file.

rius.description: Give the intended recipient a usable retrieval route, such as a link or transfer instructions, with the access permissions needed for that recipient to obtain the file.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Give the intended recipient a usable retrieval route, such as a link or transfer instructions, with the access permissions needed for that recipient to obtain the file.

rius.rationale: Uploading without giving the recipient usable access does not complete the central sharing task.

rius.description: Verify delivery using an appropriate transfer-completion or recipient-retrieval check rather than assuming success from merely starting the transfer.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Verify delivery using an appropriate transfer-completion or recipient-retrieval check rather than assuming success from merely starting the transfer.

rius.rationale: Supports reliable delivery through a concrete completion or access check without requiring both checks, checksums or a full transfer-verification framework.

notes: E4 draft; frozen prompt corpus v0.3.1, protocol 0.3, annotation schema 0.2. EN/BN/BN-CS interpretation: All variants retain only a large file exceeding email attachment capacity. A suitable file-sharing/transfer service, network transfer, physical medium or compression that actually makes the attachment fit can be valid. Compression is optional and is not assumed to work for every file. Access should match the intended audience; public information is not automatically required to use authenticated sharing.
